title: OpenTelemetry Instrumentation Plan
description: A structured plan for an OTel rollout so scripts/opentelemetry_instrumentation_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against this skill's Quality Gates.

serviceNameSet.description: True if service.name is set in the resource attributes.

serviceVersionSet.description: True if service.version is set (deploy markers).

deploymentEnvironmentSet.description: True if deployment.environment is set (env filtering).

sdkLoadOrder.description: How the SDK is loaded: a loader preload flag (-r / --import), an import at the top of the entrypoint, or after other app imports.

moduleSystem.description: The app's module system (informational; the preload flag differs between them).

multiService.description: True if traces cross more than one service (sampling decisions must be inherited).

sampler.description: Head-sampling strategy configured on this service.

samplingRatio.description: Root-span sampling ratio, if a ratio sampler is used.

exporterProtocol.description: Trace exporter in use. otlp-http-json and console are debugging-only.

spanProcessor.description: Span processor wrapping the exporter. simple is only acceptable in tests.

maxQueueSizeSet.description: True if BatchSpanProcessor maxQueueSize is set to a finite value.

errorPathsRecordException.description: True if error paths call span.recordException and set SpanStatusCode.ERROR.

latencyInstrument.description: The metric instrument used for latency/value distributions.

crossAsyncBoundaries.description: True if work crosses worker_threads, queues, or detached promises.

contextPropagatedAcrossBoundaries.description: True if W3C trace context is serialized and re-established across those boundaries.

browserFetchInstrumentation.description: True if the browser side uses FetchInstrumentation.

corsPropagationAllowlistSet.description: True if propagateTraceHeaderCorsUrls is configured for the API origins.
